cases.name: Anna Igorevna Kichatova Moses
cases.about: Anna was a University of Texas at Dallas administrator and master’s student.
cases.narrative: On 1/14/2015, police found her body in the garage of her Frisco, TX home during a welfare check. He had shot her 6 times - once in the throat, 3 times in the chest and twice in the back.

cases.name: Amy Moss Janasik
cases.about: a.k.a. Amy Michelle Cousins. Her obituary said, "She was a hairstylist for 25 years. She took great pride in what she did. Amy was always the life of the party and had a magnetic personality much so that people were naturally drawn to her. During the summer she spent all of her time at the lake or in the pool. She enjoyed crafting jewelry and spending time with her family."
cases.narrative: She was shot in the head.
